author: Madison Lim
title: Why English Bluff TorqueMasters rust from the inside — Tsawwassen's salt-air spring problem.
lede_excerpt: Tsawwassen gets less rain than the rest of Metro Vancouver — it sits in the Olympic rain shadow and averages about 950 mm a year against Vancouver's 1,189. That's not the problem. The problem is what the wind carries. Constant onshore breeze off the Strait of Georgia drops salt a…
